notes: Did not run Unity/tests/builds per constraints; PlayerManaPlayModeTests.cs and the asmdef were read for context only, not modified.
CastDenied is only raised for the insufficient-mana refusal path, not for the amount<=0 invalid-input path, to match AC-002's 'denied due to insufficient mana' wording precisely.

Denied-cast flash presentation (color + duration) on PlayerManaUI is an implementation choice per the GDD; exact visual treatment can be retuned via the new serialized fields without further code changes.
structured_output.summary: Implemented NSC-005: added PlayerMana.ResetMana() (restores full mana and clears post-cast regen-delay timer for floor restart) and a CastDenied event raised from Spend() when a cast is refused due to insufficient mana. PlayerManaUI now subscribes to CastDenied and briefly flashes the existing mana fill Image as readable low-mana feedback, satisfying the GDD's readable-failure success criterion without new scene wiring. No spell-local state was touched, preserving Player Mana's ownership boundary.
